page.overview:
Who is Sinead?

Sinead was the niece of Brokilon's ruler, Eithné, and held a high position in dryad society. If anyone managed to enter their land and the dryads had need of them for any reason, Sinead would speak with them, as such matters were considered beneath Eithné.

Some time before the Nilfgaardian invasions, the defenders of a border region of Brokilon near Eight-Mile were killed by a werewolf. Around the same time, a band of adventurers fled into Brokilon Forest to escape a group of bandits. The dryads captured the group and brought them before Sinead.

Sinead did not hide her contempt for the adventurers, speaking down to and insulting them. She informed them that a strange and dangerous monster had appeared the previous day and needed to be eliminated. She then ordered their weapons to be returned and assigned a duo of dryads to serve as their guides and guards during the hunt. Afterward, she left the group, blending into the forest.
